- GNU General Public License version 3 or later; or

This distribution retains the exact source snapshot used to create the bundled
network rules in easylist-20260817.txt. Exact upstream release, archive, source,
generated-rule hashes and the transformation policy are recorded in
easylist-provenance.json and ../easylist.lock.json.
